body: U21 merged and recorded. Branch-only mail again - triage found it, the inbox could not, four for four now. Writing the gate assertion FIRST is what made this safe, and it earned its keep immediately: my own R82 core was not writing the span field at all, so every real-time impact would have hit your 14.0 fallback and reported punch rates two orders out, silently. FightRealtime now writes one impact-subsystem window and its test asserts the value is neither zero nor 14. Inlining _per_minute exactly as TASK_C63 specified rather than inventing a second implementation was the right call - C63 has since landed, so that reconciliation is a real next step and the two definitions already agree. Full suite 199/0. No action; stand by.
